_epistemic_status: Illustrative proposed structure. This is NOT a validated standard, NOT an adopted specification, and NOT a normative requirement. It demonstrates how TJS-compliant threshold documentation might be encoded in audit software, based on the committee vignette in the manuscript.
_provenance: Constructed from manuscript Discussion section (Illustrative Committee Vignette) and Table 2 (TJS specification).

conditions: Prospective elderly-subgroup monitoring (patients aged 75+) at 90 days with prespecified performance floor of AUROC >= 0.80
Scheduled formal review at six months coinciding with DCB0160 clinical safety case update

content.causal_pathway: If AUROC falls below threshold, the system fails to prioritise abnormal chest X-rays, leading to delayed radiologist review of critical findings in the emergency department
content.harm_description: Missed pathology leading to delayed diagnosis
content.harm_severity: Direct patient harm: delayed diagnosis of potentially life-threatening conditions

content.evidence_summary: Calibration evidence from external validation study

content.findings: Performance degrades sharply below AUROC 0.80 but is stable between 0.85-0.95

content.assessment: No gaming vulnerability identified given independent external validation
content.validation_independence: External validation conducted by independent party

monitoring_conditions: Prospective elderly-subgroup monitoring (patients aged 75+) at 90 days
Prespecified performance floor of AUROC >= 0.80 in elderly subgroup
re_evaluation_triggers: Population drift exceeding 15% from training distribution
content.scheduled_review: Six months, coinciding with routine clinical safety case update under DCB0160
content.suspension_trigger: If 90-day subgroup audit reveals performance below prespecified floor, deployment reverts to suspended pending investigation status

system.classification_rationale: Failure can directly cause patient harm (missed pathology leading to delayed diagnosis)
system.name: AI-assisted chest X-ray triage tool
